p: Iron Man → The Avengers. The founding heroes get their origins and assemble.
Iron Man 3 → Ant-Man. The cosmic side opens up and cracks show in the team.
Civil War → Endgame + Far From Home. The Avengers split, then face Thanos.
WandaVision onward. The Disney+ era begins and the multiverse opens.
Quantumania → Thunderbolts*. New teams form as the stakes build.
Fantastic Four → Doomsday → Secret Wars. The finale of the Multiverse Saga.
